mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong becomes <font color='#91d7ee'>Invisible</font> and dashes in a direction, leaving behind a clone that will attack nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for @StealthDuration@ second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for @CloneDuration@ seconds.

The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing @CloneDamageMod*100@% of normal damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules><keywordStealth>Invisible</keywordStealth> units cannot be revealed except by turrets or true sight.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Wukong's extends his staff and spins it around repeatedly, gaining Move Speed.

Enemies struck take damage and are knocked up.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Wukong gains @MoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and take @TotalDamageTT@ plus @PercentHPDamageTT@ max Health physical damage over @SpinDuration@ seconds.

This Ability can be cast a second time within @RecastWindow@ seconds before going on cooldown.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Damage to jungle monsters is capped at <physicalDamage>@MonsterCapTT@ damage</physicalDamage> over @SpinDuration@ seconds.</rules>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: This unit has increased Armor and Health Regeneration. He is also extra tricky!
Wukong's ultimate is available to be cast a second time!

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Wukong gains <scaleArmor>@BonusArmor@ Armor</scaleArmor> and regenerates <healing>@HealthPercentPer5*100@% max Health per 5 seconds</healing>. These bonuses are increased by @StackMultiplier*100@% for @StackDuration@ seconds every time he or his <keywordMajor>Clone</keywordMajor> hit an enemy champion or jungle monster with an Attack or Ability, stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Wukong's next attack gains attack range, deals bonus damage, and reduces the target's armor for a few seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains @AttackRangeBonus@ range, deals an additional @BonusDamageTT@ physical damage, and removes @ArmorShredPercent*100@% Armor for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

This Ability's cooldown is reduced by @CooldownDecrease@ seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability.
